action_items: Update /app/backend/tests/test_phase4_5_ha_trials.py — 9 pre-existing tests now fail because they pick a saleable IN_STOCK serial without passing `notes`. The new trial validation (iter22) correctly rejects this. These tests need to either (a) flip the serial to demo pool first via POST /ha/serial-items/{id}/mark-demo, OR (b) pass notes='loaner from X' in the payload. This is NOT a regression bug — it is expected behaviour per the user story. Main agent should update the test fixtures to use demo-pool serials (preferred) so the old lifecycle/convert/extend tests pass again.

models_ha.py:255 Side=Literal['left','right','single','both'] — both QuoteLine and SaleLine pick this up via type alias. Verified quotation create with side='both' returns 200 and persists via test_create_quotation_with_both.

Frontend ProductCataloguePage.js:227+ — Serial Numbers section is conditional on is_serialised checkbox; ha-pf-serials-section has 2-click-add-rows flow verified; branch dropdown pre-populated with user's branches.

ModalShell.js — uses mousedown target-guard pattern (e.target === e.currentTarget on mousedown) which prevents drag-select-outside-but-release-inside from closing. Better than onClick-only guard. Verified via Playwright: clicking on select inside modal does NOT close it; clicking top-left corner (true backdrop) DOES close it.
No mongodb _id leakage seen in any of /ha/products/{id}/serials, /ha/demo-stock, /ha/serial-items/{id}/mark-demo, /ha/trials responses — all endpoints use projection {'_id': 0}.
